claim: Linkers will make up less than 9.3% of planned gilt sales in the 2027–28 remit.
judging: Judged against the 2027–28 gilt remit as first published by the Debt Management Office, normally alongside the Spring Statement. The measure is index-linked gilt sales as a share of total planned gilt sales, calculated the same way as the 9.3% quoted for 2026–27. 9.3% or above counts as wrong. If the remit has not been published by the check date, the check waits until it is.
